releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.7 — a real Discover tab. Discover now has the reference's three sections: Friends (search, presence, message / voice / video buttons, tap a row for the profile card), Requests (incoming invites with sender, @handle and how long ago they arrived, plus Accept and Decline) and Find (search every person by name or username, with Friend badges and Add, Cancel or Unfriend actions). Unfriending asks for confirmation in the reference dialog, the tab badges show live counts, and every list animates in with the staggered slide-up. Messaging or calling someone from Discover opens (or creates) the chat for them, and calls start straight away.
